patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with high-contrast background colors (vibrant yellow and deep black/dark gray) to clearly delineate content areas.
Prominent use of an extremely bold, wide sans-serif typeface for primary headings, creating a strong, impactful visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast color scheme dominated by a vibrant, almost neon yellow and deep black, with dark grays used for secondary content sections.
The hero section features 3D spherical elements rendered on a canvas that subtly parallax against the foreground text as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
Large, distinct section titles are used as strong visual anchors, often centered, to introduce new content blocks.

technique_notes: The hero section integrates a dynamic 3D canvas animation with spherical elements that subtly parallax against the foreground text as the user scrolls, creating an engaging sense of depth and movement.
Content sections are revealed with a gentle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, ensuring a smooth and modern content flow.
The overall layout utilizes full-width, high-contrast blocks to clearly define content areas, with generous vertical padding to create an airy and uncrowded feel.

fonts.family: ABC Monument Grotesk Unlicensed Trial Regular

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, wide display headings (~4-5x body text) with clean, legible body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all interactive elements, buttons, and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating an uncrowded and open feel.

standout: The striking, high-contrast color palette of vibrant yellow and deep black, combined with the dynamic, interactive 3D hero animation, immediately sets this site apart. It feels bold and modern without being overly complex, making the 'hero' concept central to its visual identity.
